mentions.name: BLE thermal printer runaway experiment
mentions.description: A reverse engineering experiment on a BLE thermal printer showing it can be driven into thermal runaway—melting half its components—without any authorization as long as the printer is turned on.
mentions.source_excerpt: Today I caused thermal runaway on a BLE  thermal (sic!) printer. That melted half of its components together before I noticed. The fun fact is you can do that witouth authorizing, as long as printer is turned on
